name: dom-layout-shim
description: Patch deterministic layout and hit testing into DOM-like test environments.

scripts.build: pnpm run css:generate && node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: pnpm run css:generate && mkdir -p .tmp .cache && TMPDIR=.tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.examples:check: pnpm run build && pnpm run examples:typecheck && pnpm run examples:test && pnpm run examples:build
scripts.examples:compatibility: pnpm run build && pnpm run examples:build && node scripts/report-example-compatibility.mjs
scripts.test:browser-parity: pnpm run css:generate && pnpm run font:check && node scripts/run-browser-parity.mjs
scripts.docs:generate: pnpm run build && pnpm run examples:build && node scripts/generate-docs-pages.mjs && node scripts/generate-changelog-page.mjs
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run build && pnpm run examples:build && pnpm run css:check && node scripts/generate-docs-pages.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-changelog-page.mjs --check
scripts.css:check: node scripts/css-support.mjs validate && node scripts/css-support.mjs generate
